notes.subject: מידעת
notes.rationale: Ketiv 'make known' (Hiphil imperative fem.) vs qere נודעת 'is known' — KJV/ASV follow qere, YLT-style imperatives follow ketiv.

notes.subject: גאות
notes.rationale: 'pride/exaltation/excellent things' — rendered as 'olgeta samting gutpela tru' after existing versions; literal is 'highness, excellency'.

notes.subject: זמרו ... מידעת
notes.rationale: Plural imperatives summoning the community to sing and make known.

translation: Salim singaut long Yahwe wantaim ol string bilong miusik, bilong em i wokim olgeta samting gutpela tru; wantaim, yu ken mekim dispela i kamap save long olgeta hap bilong graun.
